key.name: idle-timeout-seconds
key.summary: Idle timeout before the slideshow starts
key.description: Seconds of user inactivity after which the fullscreen slideshow starts (brief section 3, point 1). From 1 second (00:00:01) to 23:59:59 (86399 seconds); zero and a full day (86400) are not valid. The settings window shows it as hours, minutes and seconds.

key.name: lock-grace-period-seconds
key.description: If the first input after the slideshow starts arrives within this many seconds of the slideshow starting, the session is NOT locked. The comparison is a strict less-than (D16): a value of 0 means every input locks, since no elapsed time can be less than zero.

key.name: picture-folder
key.description: Absolute path to the folder the slideshow reads images from. An empty string (the default) means: the XDG pictures directory itself (D25), read recursively. A missing folder is not an error; the service logs it and keeps running (brief 3.7).

key.name: slide-interval-seconds
key.description: Seconds each image is shown before advancing to the next one.

key.name: order
key.description: Random order, or alphabetical by file name.

key.name: scaling
key.description: "fill" crops the image to fill the screen; "fit" shows the whole image letterboxed. "fill" is the default and it costs picture: a 3:4 portrait picture on a 16:9 monitor shows 42 % of the picture, a 9:16 phone photo 32 %; a 3:2 landscape picture shows 84 %, 4:3 75 %. Whether "fill" is the right default is an open decision; "fit" is the one-line alternative (change the default of this key).

key.name: pan-portrait-images
key.description: When true and the scaling mode is "fill", a portrait picture on a landscape monitor is scrolled slowly from top to bottom while it is shown, instead of being cropped to its middle. The default is false on purpose: the animation redraws every frame, so it costs battery. The default only changes after a battery measurement on the reference laptop (docs/measurements/pan-battery-protocol.md).
